import limiter, proxy
def sdk(lim, client, now_ms):
    status, headers = proxy.handle(lim, client, now_ms)
    if status != 429:
        return [status]
    after = int(headers['Retry-After'])
    retry, _ = proxy.handle(lim, client, now_ms + after * 1000)
    return [status, headers['Retry-After'], retry]
